import json, re, statistics
rows=[json.loads(line) for line in open('anonymous_traces.jsonl',encoding='utf-8') if line.strip()]
by_input={r['input']:r for r in rows}
problems=list(by_input.values())
terminal=re.compile(r'(?<=[。！？."'!?；;])'"\\s*|\\r?\\n+')
comma=re.compile(r'(?<=[，,])\\s*')
base_counts=[]; refined_counts=[]; prefix_lengths=[]; answers=[]; multi=0
for row in problems:
    text=row['input']
    base=[x.strip() for x in terminal.split(text) if len(x.strip())>=35]
    refined=[]
    for item in base:
        if len(item)<=620: refined.append(item)
        else: refined.extend(x.strip() for x in comma.split(item) if len(x.strip())>=35)
    base_counts.append(len(base)); refined_counts.append(len(refined))
    answers.append(row['ground_truth'])
    multi += int(';' in row['ground_truth'])
print('pooled unique problem inputs:',len(problems),'rows:',len(rows))
print('input lengths median/max:',int(statistics.median(map(lambda x:len(x['input']),problems))),max(map(lambda x:len(x['input']),problems)))
print('sentence fragments per input, terminal-only median/max:',int(statistics.median(base_counts)),max(base_counts))
print('long-input fragment split median/max:',int(statistics.median(refined_counts)),max(refined_counts))
print('distinct verified answer strings:',len(set(answers)),'answers with multiple components:',multi)
print('shared initial prompt prefix across inputs:',len(__import__('os').path.commonprefix([r['input'] for r in problems])))
'@ | python -"
